"""Seal preparation only; actual maintained completion remains a separate later seal."""

from pathlib import Path

from common import PACKAGE, ROOT, TARGET, TARGET_SHA, bind, inventory, now, read, sha, verify, write

validation = read(PACKAGE / "helper-validation.json")
assert validation["all_passed"]
for row in validation["receipts"]:
    assert row["exit_code"] == 0
    verify(row["stdout"])
    verify(row["stderr"])
assert sha(ROOT / TARGET) == TARGET_SHA
initial = read(PACKAGE / "helper-validation-initial.json")
relocated = []
for row in initial["receipts"]:
    for stream in ["stdout", "stderr"]:
        prior = row[stream]
        retained = PACKAGE / "helper-validation-initial" / Path(prior["path"]).name
        assert sha(retained) == prior["sha256"]
        relocated.append({"original_receipt_binding": prior, "retained": bind(retained)})
write(
    PACKAGE / "prior-attempt-artifact-relocation.json",
    {
        "scope": 'First successful helper check is retained after the exac'
            't checkpoint guard was added.',
        "historical_receipt": bind(PACKAGE / "helper-validation-initial.json"),
        "mapping": relocated,
        "later_receipt": bind(PACKAGE / "helper-validation.json"),
    },
)
write(
    PACKAGE / "actual-tool-receipts.json",
    {
        "accepted_packets_pin_and_43_artifact_verification": "ff9cbe/0",
        "initial_helper_tests": {"launch": "f480c5", "session": 50195, "terminal": "819f29/0"},
        "final_helper_tests": {"launch": "2fde59", "session": 66258, "terminal": "b7a5a0/0"},
        "formatting_attempts": {
            "initial_lint": "24f774/1; full repeated output retained as lint-initial.stdout",
            "fix_and_format": "08b013/0 controller; individual nonzero lint stages retained",
            "literal_wrapper_attempt": '00e21f reports in-memory formatting failure; failed sour'
                'ce was not published',
            "correction": "Skip already-short literals; exact AST comparison retained",
            "final_lint": "826200/0 and final helper-validation lint exit 0",
        },
        "final_complete_package_lint": "4b1af5/0",
        "maintained_mutations": False,
        "scope": 'Preparation checks only; no gate, preservation, saved re'
            'view or history completion claim.',
    },
)
rows = []
for relative in inventory(PACKAGE):
    if relative in {"artifact-manifest.json", "handoff.json"}:
        continue
    rows.append({"relative_path": relative, **bind(PACKAGE / relative)})
write(
    PACKAGE / "artifact-manifest.json",
    {
        "inventory": "rg --no-ignore --hidden --follow; no hidden/ignored artifact omitted",
        "artifacts": rows,
    },
)
write(
    PACKAGE / "handoff.json",
    {
        "status": "sealed_external_finalization_preparation_only",
        "at": now(),
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "target_sha256": TARGET_SHA,
        "preparer": "/root/lyxose_author",
        "role": 'Original author; saved payload uses self_review and expl'
            'icit independent inheritance.',
        "manifest": bind(PACKAGE / "artifact-manifest.json"),
        "artifact_count": len(rows),
        "accepted_bindings": bind(PACKAGE / "accepted-bindings.json"),
        "actual_preparation_status": bind(PACKAGE / "preparation-status.json"),
        "validation": bind(PACKAGE / "helper-validation.json"),
        "receipt_contract": bind(PACKAGE / "receipt-contract.json"),
        "readme": bind(PACKAGE / "README.md"),
        "helper_tests": 10,
        "native_inspect_smoke": "passed; target and two rubric inputs only",
        "old_records_pages": 227,
        "old_review_bundles": 101,
        "actual_complete_checkpoint_files": 6444,
        "maintained_writes": False,
        "saved_maintained_review": False,
        "session_history_created": False,
        "full_gate_result_claimed": False,
        "final_sealing_requires": [
            "actual completed gate/preservation/QA receipts and root acceptance",
            "native inspect/validate/save/history/validate-history/check receipts",
            "exact archived additions and post-finalization preservation",
        ],
        "external_issue_keys": [
            "lyxose-plar-kdgr-reciprocal-expression-omission",
            "lyxose-pectin-digest-reporter-context-omission",
        ],
        "source_exhaustion": False,
    },
)
for row in rows:
    verify(row)
print(
    {
        "handoff": bind(PACKAGE / "handoff.json"),
        "artifact_count": len(rows),
        "manifest": bind(PACKAGE / "artifact-manifest.json"),
    }
)
